title: Does Vienna Have the World's Best Council Housing? Swimming Pools, Private TV Channels & More
summary: Channel 4's George Clarke visits a council estate in Vienna and is surprised by amenities such as swimming pools and private TV channels. It showcases Vienna's high-quality social housing.
why: HN points to it as proof that government-provided housing can be attractive, in housing and homelessness threads.

quote.text: See this video for what government provided housing could be.
